dict.string: Shared Mouse Keyboard finds and connects to your other computers on the local network.
When you paste files copied on another computer into a Finder window, Shared Mouse Keyboard asks Finder which folder you are pasting into and saves the files there.
To share files you copy from the Desktop with your other computers.
To share files you copy from Documents with your other computers.
To share files you copy from Downloads with your other computers.
To share files you copy from external disks, and to save files pasted onto them.
To share files you copy from network drives, and to save files pasted onto them.
